proposition: After the fall of Isfahan in 789/1387 the Turka family was spared and sent to Temür's court at Samarkand (Ṣadr al-Dīn, his son Afżal al-Dīn and the teenaged Ṣāʾin al-Dīn), where Temür appointed the elder brother Ṣadr al-Dīn qadi.

mediation.who: the sparing of the Turka family
